'''Locris Syndicated Securities''', also known as '''Loris Syndicated Securities''',<ref name="GG10" /> was a manufacturer of security technology, including [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]] and mobile [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] cages. Their product line included [[SC-401 stun cuffs]],<ref name="EGWT" /> [[MCI-100 magnacuffs/Legends|MCI-100]] [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]], and [[MCI-200]] [[magnaharness]]es.<ref name="GG10" />
